notes.title: Finally, scientific proof that Smash Bros. would be better with shotgun-toting crabs
notes.content: When a game developer asks "Do you play Dark Souls?", they're usually going to follow that question with a demo of a densely interconnected game world or a punishing combat system, something clearly influenced by FromSoftware's RPG series. This is the first time someone's asked me if I've played Dark Souls and then showed me a game about crabs with M16s... Read more.
